title: Memory Read/Write Portable Intent
description: Write one PSS read-after-write memory intent and inspect the generated UVM sequence and C bare-metal equivalents.

steps.title: Step 1: Complete the Write Action
steps.instructions: Open `starter/mem_test.pss` and add the 4-byte address alignment constraint plus the `0x0000` through `0xffff` data range constraint.

steps.title: Step 2: Bind Read-Verify to the Write
steps.instructions: Add the `write_mem` input handle to `read_verify`, then bind `rd.wr == wr` in the activity graph so the read checks the exact write action.

steps.title: Step 3: Compare Generated Targets
steps.instructions: Review `solution/generated_uvm_sequence.sv` and `solution/generated_baremetal_test.c`; identify how the same PSS constraints become UVM randomization and C helper calls.
